      "stride": "Spoofing",
      "title": "Anyone who can reach the queue can impersonate the planner and trigger card charges",
      "scenario": "The agents exchange tasks over a shared queue with no authentication, so any internal service, compromised container or staff member with network access can publish a message that looks like it came from the planner agent.       "impact": 5,

      "cwe": ["CWE-306", "CWE-290"],
      "plainLanguage": "The agents trust any message on the shared queue, so someone could fake a 'please pay' message and charge a customer's card.",

        "title": "Authenticate every message between agents",
        "given": "a message arrives on the shared agent queue",
        "when": "the payments or flights agent consumes it",
        "then": "the agent verifies a per-agent credential or signed envelope identifying the sending agent and the originating user session, and rejects unauthenticated or unsigned messages"

    {
      "stride": "ElevationOfPrivilege",
      "title": "Payments agent holds standing authority to charge the saved card with no per-booking approval",
      "scenario": "The payments agent is designed so it can charge the user's saved card on instruction from another agent. Because the authority is standing rather than scoped to one approved itinerary and amount, any instruction that reaches it (hijacked planner, forged queue message, agent bug) converts directly into money movement. An attacker who influences one step of the chain gets the full charging capability, repeatedly and for arbitrary amounts.",
      "component": "Payments agent -> card processor",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "medium", "reach": "many", "harm": "money" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The payments agent can charge the user’s saved card." }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-269", "CWE-862"],
      "plainLanguage": "The payments agent can always charge the card, so any bad instruction becomes a real payment.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Scope each charge to an approved itinerary and amount",
        "given": "the payments agent is asked to charge a saved card",
        "when": "it calls the payment processor",
        "then": "it requires a single-use authorization bound to the specific user session, itinerary and maximum amount, and refuses any charge without a matching unused authorization"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Tampering",
      "title": "Agent goal hijack through untrusted flight content",
      "scenario": "The flights agent reads supplier search results and passes them to the planner. The planner, an LLM, treats that content as a task and delegates a payment to the payments agent, which can charge the saved card. The attacker needs only to control text in a listing the agents read.",
      "component": "Flights agent -> planner agent",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "rating": { "attacker": "anyone", "effort": "medium", "reach": "many", "harm": "money" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "A planner agent delegates to a flights agent and a payments agent." },
        { "quote": "The payments agent can charge the user’s saved card." }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-74", "CWE-77"],
      "plainLanguage": "Text inside flight listings could tell the AI planner to pay for something, and it would obey.",

        "title": "Treat supplier content as data, not instructions",
        "given": "the flights agent returns supplier search results to the planner",
        "when": "the planner builds its next action",

      "component": "Shared message queue",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "rating": { "attacker": "insider", "effort": "medium", "reach": "many", "harm": "money" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Agents pass messages through a shared queue without authentication." }

      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-345", "CWE-472"],
      "plainLanguage": "Nothing protects the messages, so a price or itinerary could be changed before payment happens.",

        "title": "Integrity-protect payment-relevant messages",

      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "insider", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "sensitive_data" },

        { "quote": "Agents pass messages through a shared queue without authentication." }

      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-200", "CWE-311"],
      "plainLanguage": "Anyone able to listen to the shared queue can read customers' travel and payment details.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Restrict and minimise data on the shared queue",
        "given": "agent messages contain traveller or payment data",
        "when": "they transit the shared queue",
        "then": "subscription requires an authenticated per-agent identity, and card data is replaced by a reference resolvable only by the payments agent"
      }
    },

      "stride": "ElevationOfPrivilege",
      "title": "No human confirmation before money leaves the user's card",

      "component": "Planner agent -> payments agent handoff",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "money" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "A planner agent delegates to a flights agent and a payments agent." },
        { "quote": "The payments agent can charge the user’s saved card." }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-862"],
      "plainLanguage": "The AI can buy a flight with the saved card without the person saying yes to the final price.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Require explicit user confirmation for every charge",
        "given": "a booking is ready to pay",
        "when": "the payments agent is about to charge the saved card",
        "then": "the exact amount, currency and itinerary are shown to the user and the charge proceeds only after a confirmation action tied to that user's authenticated session"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "DenialOfService",
      "title": "Delegation loop between agents causes repeated bookings and runaway cost",
      "scenario": "The planner delegates to the flights and payments agents over a queue with no sender checks, so a retried, replayed or echoed message can re-enter the chain. An attacker can deliberately replay one captured message many times because no identity or idempotency key gates it.",
      "component": "Planner / flights / payments agent loop",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "insider", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "money" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "A planner agent delegates to a flights agent and a payments agent." },
        { "quote": "Agents pass messages through a shared queue without authentication." }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-837", "CWE-799"],
      "plainLanguage": "The same booking message could be repeated, charging the card and booking seats over and over.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Idempotency and loop limits on agent tasks",
        "given": "a booking or charge task is processed",
        "when": "the same task identifier is seen again or the delegation depth exceeds a configured limit",
        "then": "the task is rejected as a duplicate, the charge is not repeated, and the loop is halted and alerted"

      "component": "Shared message queue / payments agent audit trail",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "rating": { "attacker": "insider", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "minor" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Agents pass messages through a shared queue without authentication." },
        { "quote": "The payments agent can charge the user’s saved card." }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-778"],
      "plainLanguage": "If a customer disputes a charge, there is no way to prove which agent or person caused it.",

        "title": "Bind every charge to an attributable decision chain",
